meta.title: Git sidebar
meta.description: Adds a Git panel to the left sidebar: one row opens a panel that will show the current repository's branch, working-tree status, and recent commits. This first version registers the sidebar row and an empty placeholder panel; repository inspection is not implemented yet.

panel.label: Git
panel.emptyBody: This panel will show the branch, working-tree status, and recent commits of the session's workspace. Repository inspection arrives in a later version.
